# SurgeX

> AI-powered digital marketing agency for local businesses, based in Lisbon, Portugal. We put a business online and bring it customers: website, Google Maps and other listings, local SEO and GEO/AEO, automatic customer care, social media and campaigns — all built and run with AI. Founded by Sebastião Guimarães.

Contact: +351 915 109 181 | contact@surgex.pt
Website: https://www.surgex.pt
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/351915109181
Location: Lisbon, Portugal

60+ projects delivered across 15+ niches. 48-hour average website delivery. Bilingual: Portuguese and English. Works 100% online across Portugal.

## Services

- [Online Presence](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/online-presence): Premium bilingual website delivered in 48 hours, plus listings created and kept up to date on Google Maps / Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, TripAdvisor and Bing
- [Get Found](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/get-found): Local SEO and GEO/AEO — appearing on Google and in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews
- [Automatic Customer Care](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/customer-care): AI chatbot trained on the business, WhatsApp button, automatic follow-ups, automatic Google review requests, missed-call replies
- [Social Media & Content](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/social-media): Monthly calendar, posts and images generated with AI in the brand's voice, automatic publishing on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn
- [Campaigns & Outreach](https://www.surgex.pt/en/services/campaigns): Prospecting by email and WhatsApp, newsletters and reactivation campaigns, Google and Meta ads when they make sense

## Pricing

- Setup: 500€ one-time (half at kickoff, half on approval) — website in 48h, listings on Google Maps, Apple Maps, TripAdvisor and Bing, domain and email setup, first SEO pass
- Presence: 35€/month — hosting, updates, listings kept current, support
- Growth (recommended): 65€/month — Presence + local SEO and GEO, AI chatbot, WhatsApp, review requests, follow-ups
- Complete: 100€/month — Growth + social media, campaigns and newsletters, monthly results report
- No lock-in contract. Ad spend is always the client's own budget.
